assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Production game sprite extraction from the APPROVED princess portrait. Output ONLY her bare head, two bare ears, face and short neck, on genuine transparent alpha. Remove ALL hair, crown, hairclip, earrings, necklace, sparkles, mirror, background and anything below the neck. Reconstruct a smooth complete bald scalp where the hair was, in the same softly shaded skin tone. This is an intermediate compositing layer for a hair game, not a new character. CRITICAL preserve the approved face exactly: the same very wide round cheeks, big round purple sparkling eyes, brows, little nose, smile, skin shading and proportions. Do not lengthen or narrow the face. Keep the same frontal pose and ORIGINAL canvas aspect ratio 5:6 and original facial landmark positions and scale; do not recenter, zoom, crop or make the face smaller. Head centered horizontally; eyes at approximately 49% of image height, lips at 65%, chin at 75%, neck ending at 90%. Eyebrows remain golden brown. Keep only a light natural rose lip tint and very subtle natural cheek color so users can paint makeup. No painted eyeshadow, no heavy eyeliner beyond natural eyelashes. No shoulders, clothes, upper chest or body. Transparent empty padding where removed hair/background were. Edges must be clean smooth alpha; no white matte, no checkerboard printed in image. Retain the high-quality soft storybook illustration finish of the approved reference.

Production sprite extraction from the approved princess reference: output ONLY her entire beautiful golden blonde hairstyle, fully isolated on genuine transparent alpha. Preserve exactly the approved hairstyle, golden color, detailed luminous fine painted strands, wavy side locks, softly curled ends and soft storybook finish. Remove the entire face, scalp, ears, neck, all skin, tiara/crown, butterfly hairclip, earrings, necklace, mirror, frame, background, and sparkles. A completely transparent face-shaped opening must remain where her face was. Reconstruct the small hair areas beneath the removed crown and butterfly, continuing the same hairstyle seamlessly. Keep the exact original frontal composition and canvas aspect ratio 5:6, same scale and landmark placement as reference, never zoom or crop. Full hair including top and all long curled ends entirely in frame. No facial features, skin, accessories, clothes, body, text or extra objects. No white matte, no printed checkerboard. This is the separate editable hair layer for an interactive princess hair salon game; it will be composited over the separately extracted head layer.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Create a production sprite atlas of TWELVE separate princess jewelry accessories matching the approved reference's refined golden filigree, lavender crystal and luminous pearl storybook illustration style. Genuine transparent alpha background, portrait 3:4 canvas divided into EXACTLY THREE equal columns and FOUR equal rows. Each item isolated, centered in its own equal square cell with 15 percent clear padding, no item overlaps cell boundary. NO dividing lines, no grid, no text, no labels, no numbers, no heads or people. All ornaments front facing to overlay a frontal princess portrait. Row 1 left: elegant dainty golden filigree tiara with lilac gemstones like reference crown; center: gold rose royal crown with pink gems; right: arc-shaped small pink rose and lavender flower wreath. Row 2 left: lavender satin bow; center: delicate jeweled lavender butterfly hair clip like reference; right: pink rose hair clip with tiny golden leaves. Row 3 left: ONE dangling pearl earring with lilac gemstone stud; center: ONE small golden star earring; right: ONE pink heart gemstone earring. Row 4 left: curved U-shaped delicate short pearl necklace; center: curved U-shaped delicate gold chain with pink ruby pendant; right: curved U-shaped fine golden chain with small crescent moon pendant. Necklaces open at top; no skin. Ensure equal 3 columns by 4 rows spacing is precise. These are small luxury accessories, fine details and soft luminous shading, NOT thick black outlines or flat cartoon icons. Do not include any background decoration, stars, sparkles outside the accessories, frame or checkerboard.
